description: Turns a project into a link that opens it in Perfboard Designer: the project travels inside the link, so it works without any server. Give the link to the user. Also returns `image`, the address of an SVG picture of the board (as the editor draws it), for showing it where images from links display, e.g. in Markdown (not in Claude or ChatGPT, which don't load them: show_board shows the board there). With store, the project is also stored on the Perfboard Designer server under a short id, and `stored` gives a short link to it, its file and its pictures (SVG and PNG): give the user both links. The project is validated first (against expectNets too, given or remembered for its projectId); a project with errors gets the list of problems instead of a link, unless allowErrors is set.

allowErrors.description: Make the link even if validation finds errors.

editorUrl.description: The editor's address. Defaults to https://perfboarddesigner.com/app/ (set PERFBOARD_EDITOR_URL in the server's environment to change it); use e.g. http://localhost:3000/app/ for a local copy.

expectNets.description: The nets the board should make: each a list of pins written REF.pin, e.g. [["U1.8", "U1.4", "R1.1", "J1.1"], ["U1.2", "U1.6", "C1.+"]]. A pin can also be named by its label ("U1.VCC", "D1.K") or as get_nets writes it ("U1.8 VCC"). List every net of two or more pins: a pin in none of them should connect to nothing. With a projectId it's remembered for that project, so later checks use it too; [] forgets it.

name.description: The project's name in the editor, e.g. "555 LED blinker". Defaults to the name it was given in new_project or came with from read_share_link.

project.description: The whole project file: a version 3 project object, or its JSON text (see the perfboard://docs/project-file resource). Give this or projectId.

projectId.description: The id of a project kept here (from new_project, validate_project, edit_project or read_share_link), instead of sending the whole project.

store.description: Also store the project at https://projects.perfboarddesigner.com, for a short link. A stored project never changes (store again for a new id) and is deleted after a year unopened.

storeAs.description: The id you'd like it stored under, e.g. "led-blinker" (made lowercase letters, digits and dashes); if another board has it, a few characters of this board's hash are added. Implies store. Defaults to the project's name.

name: make_share_link
title: Make share link
